novel_features.name: Collection / dunning queue
novel_features.description: See every customer with an outstanding or overdue invoice, how much is owed, and the next collection action (send reminder, retry payment, or resend pay link).
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local join across invoices, customers, and payments that no single API call returns, plus amount rendering in minor currency units.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to answer who owes money and what to do next without firing dozens of API calls.

novel_features.name: Subscriptions at-risk
novel_features.description: Surface active subscriptions whose saved payment method is expired, unconfirmed, or deleted, or that have recent failed collection attempts, ranked by recovery urgency.
novel_features.rationale: Joins subscriptions, payment methods, and failed payments locally to flag involuntary churn risk that no endpoint exposes directly.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this before renewal season to fix expiring cards instead of discovering silent churn after the fact.

novel_features.name: CFDI tax-invoice reconciliation
novel_features.description: Cross-check completed or refunded payments and paid invoices against SAT tax-invoice status (VALID/CANCELED/PENDING) to find timbre gaps before monthly SAT filing.
novel_features.rationale: Only a local join across tax invoices, payments, and invoices can flag every completed payment missing a valid SAT timbre in one pass.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before SAT filing to catch completed payments missing a VALID CFDI instead of eyeballing two exported lists.

novel_features.name: Revenue report
novel_features.description: Aggregate payments and refunds by status, type, and currency over a window; see net collected vs returned in localized minor-currency amounts.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates local payments and refunds data for net revenue math that the API delivers only as raw records.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to answer how much money actually landed last month and what came back in refunds.

novel_features.name: Webhook delivery health
novel_features.description: Aggregate webhook delivery events by status per endpoint and surface PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_FAILED events as an operational alert with a retry path.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates local webhook-event status across endpoints and flags payment-failure signals no single API endpoint summarizes.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use on-call to spot failed webhook deliveries and refund/failure signals fast instead of polling dashboards.

novel_features.name: Customer balance drill-down
novel_features.description: Render a one-screen financial snapshot for a single customer: outstanding invoices, active subscriptions, payment methods, and CFDI linkage.
novel_features.rationale: A single-key multi-entity local join of invoices, subscriptions, payment methods, payments, and tax invoices for one customer.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before calling a customer about money so you have their full financial picture in one command.

narrative.headline: Every Quentli payments, invoicing, and SAT tax-billing endpoint, plus offline collection, reconciliation, and at-risk-subscription intelligence no other Quentli tool has.
narrative.value_prop: Quentli is the Stripe-like payments, cobranza, and facturación platform for Latin America. This CLI mirrors your customers, invoices, payments, subscriptions, tax invoices (SAT CFDI), and webhook events into a local database, then answers the questions ops and finance actually ask: who's behind on an invoice, which subscriptions are about to fail, which completed payments lack a valid SAT timbre, and what your net revenue really is — all offline and agent-native.
narrative.auth_narrative: Authenticate with an organization API key. Set QUENTLI_SECRET_KEY to your sk_... secret key; every command sends Authorization: Bearer <key>. Do not share or commit the key.

quickstart.comment: Health check — confirms the CLI, config, and auth wiring work without hitting the API.
Pull your portfolio into the local mirror so offline commands have data.
See every customer with an outstanding or overdue invoice and the next collection action.
Drill into one customer's full financial snapshot before contacting them.
Catch completed payments missing a valid SAT CFDI before monthly filing.

troubleshoots.symptom: Every command returns 401 "You are not authenticated"
troubleshoots.fix: Your QUENTLI_SECRET_KEY is missing or wrong. Set it and run quentli-pp-cli doctor.

troubleshoots.symptom: Offline commands report a missing or stale mirror
troubleshoots.fix: Run quentli-pp-cli sync --resources customers,invoices,payments,subscriptions,tax-invoices,webhook-events --full and pass --db if you moved the database.
All amounts are in minor currency units; these commands render them as MXN 1,500.00 automatically.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this CLI when you need to run collections, reconcile revenue or SAT CFDI tax invoices, protect recurring subscriptions, or answer any cross-entity money question across your Quentli portfolio. It shines for automation and agent workflows where firing one API call per customer is too slow and you want the answer offline from the local mirror.
